description: Clustered top level (clusterTraceScene, PARITY 8.9): the unchanged walk on scenes whose meshes are cut into clusters (limits 1, 4 on every record, 64), in f32 and quantized nodes, records and indexed leaves, merged; against the CPU reference on the oracle cases, the plain scene's GPU answers ray for ray, shared-edge quads (no slips) and the closest-point query's distances.
